salary_details.pay_scale: Consolidated honorarium of Rs.45,000 per month plus Rs.5,000 per month conveyance

Consolidated honorarium of Rs.45,000 per month plus Rs.5,000 per month conveyance

Retired or resigned Telangana/State Judicial Service officer; or Telangana Judicial Ministerial and Subordinate Services officer not below Superintendent rank with a law degree; or Section Officer and above in High Court Services with a law degree; or non-practicing Advocate with at least five years' practice and above 45 years of age; or retired Gazetted officer with a Law Degree or the Criminal Judicial Test who exercised Magisterial powers for at least three years.

content_sections.heading: Mahabubnagar District Court Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 3894/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download Mahabubnagar District Court notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Has held any post in Telangana Judicial Services or State Judicial Services and retired or resigned; Has held a post in the Telangana Judicial Ministerial and Subordinate Services not below the rank of Superintendent of District Court or Senior Civil Judge's Court or Junior Civil Judge's Court and has a law degree; Has held a post of Section Officer and above in the High Court Services (High Court for the State of Telangana / erstwhile High Court of Andhra Pradesh) and has Law Degree; Non-practicing Advocate with practice at the Bar of not less than five years and above 45 years of age; Retired Gazetted officer possessing Law Degree or who has passed the Criminal Judicial Test (Full test of Indian Penal Code and Code of Criminal Procedure) conducted by the Andhra Pradesh / Telangana State Public Service Commission and has exercised Magisterial powers for not less than three years Experience: Practice at the Bar of not less than five years (non-practicing Advocates); Magisterial powers for not less than three years (retired Gazetted officers) Age limit: Has at least one year to complete 65 years of age; non-practicing Advocate above 45 years of age (as on the date fixed by the Court in the year of recruitment) Other conditions: Special Judicial Magistrate of Second Class Courts function five days a week, Monday to Friday, between 7.30 a.m. and 10.30 a.m. May be removed without show cause for failing to attend three consecutive sittings without written permission of the Chief Judicial Magistrate Powers automatically stand withdrawn on attaining the age of 65 years Desirable: A suitable retired Judicial Officer shall be preferred

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Mahabubnagar District Court Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Practicing Advocate Member of any State or Local Authority, State Legislature or Parliament Person dismissed, removed or compulsorily retired from State/Union/Local Authority service or given a major penalty for misconduct Person convicted for an offence involving moral delinquency or facing pending proceedings for moral turpitude Person of unsound mind, deaf, mute, blind, suffering from Leprosy or contagious disease, or an insolvent/undischarged insolvent Contractor, businessman or one interested in a subsisting contract or work for Government or Local Authority within whose limits the Magistrate discharges duties

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Term of one year from the date of assuming charge, or such term as directed by the Hon'ble High Court, under Section 11 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023

content_sections.heading: How Will Mahabubnagar District Court Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Applications received will be forwarded to the Hon'ble High Court as per Circular No.17/2021, Roc.No.2289/SO/2021, dt.27.09.2021 Selection and appointment subject to the orders of the Hon'ble High Court Applications are forwarded to the Hon'ble High Court; selection and appointment are subject to its orders

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Attested Photostat copies of certificates Latest passport size photograph attested by a Gazetted Officer Proof of date of retirement and proof of date of birth Proof of judicial powers exercised (Government Order and number) Non Practicing Certificate (non-practicing Advocates) Duly stamped (for registered post) self-addressed postal cover

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Mahabubnagar District Court Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the prescribed application format enclosed with the notification. Attach requisite attested Photostat copies of certificates. Enclose a duly stamped (for registered post) self-addressed postal cover. Submit the application in TRIPLICATE to the office of the Principal District and Sessions Court, Mahabubnagar. Applications must be submitted on or before 05.12.2026 till 5.00 PM; applications received after due date will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications received after due date will not be considered The appointing Authority reserves the right to cancel the notification without assigning any reason No T.A. will be paid for the journey performed in connection with recruitment

faq.answer: Yes. Person convicted for an offence involving moral delinquency or facing pending proceedings for moral turpitude.
